title: Rank Shift Report
description:
## Task

Runners cross a finish line one after another, and `xs[i]` is the time of the runner who crossed in position `i`. For each runner, report how many runners who crossed later posted a strictly smaller time.

## Input

- `xs` — a list of integers; values may repeat.

## Output

A list of the same length where entry `i` is the number of indices `j > i` with `xs[j] < xs[i]`. Comparing every pair is too slow for the largest inputs; an n log n method is expected.

## Example

```python
smaller_after_counts([5, 2, 6, 1])  # returns [2, 1, 1, 0]
smaller_after_counts([3, 3, 3])  # returns [0, 0, 0]
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `xs` ≤ 5·10^4
- -10^9 ≤ each value ≤ 10^9
